top_signals.title: Fed Might Hike 50 Bps in December, Carlyle's Thomas Says
top_signals.summary: Jason Thomas, Carlyle’s head of global research and investment strategy, discusses the hotter-than-expected U.S. consumer price data and the implications for Federal Reserve monetary policy. Speaking on "Bloomberg Open Interest," Thomas also comments on AI investment risks. (Source: Bloomberg)
